title: Bad Seeing or Bad Thinking? Rewarding Perception for Multimodal Reasoning

layout.note: A grey panel holds a green VLM region at centre left; User Request and the visual inputs sit at the left edge, the blindfolded reasoner at top centre and the outcome verifier at lower right, linked by wide pale block arrows that run as a rectangular loop around the VLM.

lesson: Split a model's ability into two cartoon heads (an eye for seeing, a brain for thinking) inside one tinted region and surround it with wide pale block-arrow loops that carry the verifier's signals, each loop named by a red label; a blindfolded character makes 'cannot see' instantly readable.
